messages:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate for inference-runtime in us-west-2 (route: /v1/generate). Alert: 5xx spike > 5% for 3m. Severity: P1.
Ben (oncall): I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now.
Ben (oncall): seeing 5xx ~7% across gateway, spikes correlate with long latency tails and a bunch of segfaults in model-runner pods.
Alice (sre): confirming from logs: repeated `SIGSEGV` in /opt/runtime/lib/attn_kernel.so on several pods. OOM messages also present intermittently.
Carla (runtime): ah — that attn kernel got a recent perf patch in last deploy. Rolling back to previous kernel build asap.
Ben (oncall): rolling back canary of runtime image to image:v2026.01-prev now. ops-bot, kick rollout.
ops-bot: Rollout initiated: runtime-service -> image:v2026.01-prev (20% -> 100% over 5m).
Dmitri (customer-success): any customer-facing impact? which tenants hit?
Alice (sre): initial impact scan: ~2.3% of requests are 5xx overall, higher on the experimental cluster serving AcmeCorp and BetaShop. Latency p95 increased to 2.4s.
Carla (runtime): I'm attaching the short crash log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:07:11Z] model-runner[pid=4123]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f6b12abc123 sp 0x7ffcb1b2
[2026-03-15T12:07:11Z] kernel: oom_kill_process: Killed process 4123 (model-runner) total-vm: 12345678kB
[2026-03-15T12:07:12Z] coredump: wrote core to /var/crash/core.model-runner.4123
```
Carla (runtime): pattern: segfault in fused attention path when sequence length > 1024 and KV cache growth. Might be a regression in allocation.
Ben (oncall): rollback is at 40% and errors start to drop on those pods. p50/p95 returning to normal on rolled pods.
Alice (sre): patching quick mitigation: set env RUNTIME_ATTENTION_FUSE=0 for hot pods to force non-fused code path while we investigate. Doing a k8s patch to deployment now.
Carla (runtime): good. That will avoid the buggy kernel. I'll start building a hotfix with bounds checks.
Ben (oncall): applied env change cluster-wide for runtime-replicas:patched. ops-bot reports new pods ready. Observability: 5xx now down to 0.9% and dropping.
Dmitri (customer-success): pinging AcmeCorp for heads up. pushing incident note to customers affected.
Elaine (product): estimate customer impact window? need to decide whether to public post.
Alice (sre): rough calc: ~27 minutes of elevated 5xx affecting 3 regional deployments, impacting ~0.8% of total requests cumulatively; AcmeCorp saw ~1.2% error rate and a few dropped completions.
Carla (runtime): hotfix build in progress. I have a repro locally using a synthetic workload: seq_len=1536, batch=8, kv_cache growth pattern triggers allocation race. Root cause likely unchecked realloc on KV buffer in fused path.
Ben (oncall): documenting mitigation timeline: 12:07 - pager, 12:09 - rollback start, 12:16 - env flag applied, 12:25 - errors under 1%.
ops-bot: Rollout complete: runtime-service -> image:v2026.01-prev (100%).
Alice (sre): we still see a few OOM kills on older nodes; I'm cordoning and draining suspect nodes for GC and then redeploying.
Carla (runtime): ETA for hotfix image build+test: ~35m. Once validated we'll schedule canary and controlled rollout.
Dmitri (customer-success): Sent messages to impacted customers: AcmeCorp, BetaShop. Provided ETA for full fix and mitigation steps. They requested notes about data integrity — no inference results were persisted server-side, only short-lived outputs; logs retained for debugging.
Ben (oncall): handing off to Carla for runtime follow-up. Ben -> Carla. I'll stick on the thread for any further escalation.
Carla (runtime): taking over. I'll attach PR and test logs when ready. Quick note: adding an emergency feature flag `ATTN_SAFE_REALLOC=1` for customers who want to opt-in to safer allocator until full fix.
Elaine (product): good call on flag; let's avoid churn in API though. Keep it internal for now and enable per-tenant through routing if needed.
Alice (sre): I'm creating an incident ticket with severity P1, linking this slack thread and attaching graphs + affected request ids. Postmortem owner: Carla.
Carla (runtime): creating PR: fix/kv-realloc-bounds-check, CI running unit + synthetic perf tests. Will request review from Alice and Ben.
Ben (oncall): any signs of related regressions in other regions?
Alice (sre): quick sweep: eu-central shows similar segfault pattern but lower frequency; us-east unaffected currently. Looks like rollout of the kernel patch was staggered.
Carla (runtime): I'll coordinate a restricted rollout of hotfix to eu and us-west after CI green. Also add an e2e with long-seq inputs to prevent regression.
Dmitri (customer-success): customers appreciate the quick mitigation. Request from AcmeCorp: run a replay on their dropped requests if possible. We should coordinate privacy and replay scope.
Carla (runtime): we can re-run synthetic replays against a canary if consent provided. Let's follow standard CS replay checklist.
Alice (sre): next steps: 1) finalize hotfix and test 2) canary deploy 3) monitor 4) postmortem with timeline and RCA 5) remediation/backport to private deployments.
Ben (oncall): adding `pager-handoff` tag and closing active pager once metrics stable for 30m.
ops-bot: Pager closed: metrics stable. Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0315-042.
Carla (runtime): PR merged at 12:58, canary started at 13:05, no segfaults in 10m of synthetic load. Scheduling 30m controlled rollout.
Ben (oncall): thanks all. I'll update on-call log and hand off final remediation to Carla.
Alice (sre): please add postmortem owner and timeline to ticket. I'll follow up with capacity/eviction notes and node remediation steps.
Dmitri (customer-success): I'll follow up with AcmeCorp and BetaShop with final summary and link to postmortem when available.
Carla (runtime): Postmortem owner noted. Will produce RCA with code diff, test cases, CVE check, and remediation for Dedicated and Private deployments.
Elaine (product): include a blurb about how we improved detection and an optional tenant flag for safe realloc. Good work team. :thumbsup:
Ben (oncall): closing my handoff — ping me if anything spikes.
incidents-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated; impacted_customers=["AcmeCorp","BetaShop"]; mitigation=env flag + rollback; next_action=hotfix rollout; ticket=INC-2026-0315-042.
